testo:
■ If you have 5 or more Mutopias, you may summon this creature for no cost. If you do, return all your non-evolution creatures to your hand.
■ Neo Evolution: You may put it on one of your water creatures.
Triple Breaker
■ If this is a Neo Evolution Creature, it gets +10000 power and "world breaker". (A creature that has "world breaker" breaks all shields.)
